question: Jallianwala Bagh is located in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amritsar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh** is located in **Amritsar**, a city in the state of **Punjab**, India. It is near the famous **Golden Temple**, a major religious site for Sikhs.
 
• The site is historically significant due to the tragic **Jallianwala Bagh massacre**, which took place on **13 April 1919**. Thousands of peaceful protestors were killed and injured when British forces opened fire under orders from **General Dyer**.
 
• Jallianwala Bagh is now preserved as a **national memorial**. It serves as a reminder of the sacrifices made during India’s freedom struggle.
 
• The memorial includes a **Martyrs' Well**, into which many people jumped to escape the firing, and bullet marks on the walls, which are still visible.
 
• Every year, the site is visited by tourists and locals who pay homage to the **martyrs** and reflect on India’s history of colonial resistance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amritsar:**

 
 
• Amritsar is a major cultural, religious, and historical city in Punjab, India.
 
• It is renowned for the **Golden Temple**, also known as **Harmandir Sahib**, which is considered the holiest shrine in Sikhism.
 
• Amritsar was founded by **Guru Ram Das**, the fourth Sikh Guru, in **1577**.
 
• The city is famous for its **Punjabi culture, cuisine**, and handicrafts.
 
 
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre:**
 
 
• Occurred on **13 April 1919**, coinciding with the **Baisakhi festival**, which is celebrated by Sikhs and Punjabis.
